overview: A one-page Department of State list of papers, compiled in 1945 for the Formosa/Taiwan expositions and exhibitions subject file, describing a May 24, 1940 report from Taihoku by Warner. The indexed report concerned a Taiwan Chamber of Commerce–sponsored delegation of Taiwanese businessmen who held a sample fair of Taiwan products in Manila during late April and early May 1940, including a list of the articles exhibited.

people.name: Gerald Warner
people.role: U.S. diplomatic officer at Taihoku; author of the indexed report

subfiles.title: List of papers on the Manila sample fair of Taiwan products
subfiles.about: A filing-list entry summarizes Warner's May 24, 1940 report on a Taiwan products sample fair held in Manila.
subfiles.summary: The sheet indexes Taihoku report no. 107, submitted by Warner on May 24, 1940. It states that the Taiwan Chamber of Commerce in Taihoku sponsored a trip by Taiwanese businessmen to Manila, where they exhibited samples of Taiwan products during late April and early May. The underlying report included a list of the articles taken to Manila and additional information about the venture.

interest: The document offers a compact lead to evidence about Japanese colonial Taiwan's commercial outreach to the Philippines shortly before the Pacific War. Its reference to a product list in the underlying report suggests potentially valuable material for studying Taiwan's export economy, trade promotion, and regional business networks. The 1945 compilation date also shows how the State Department retrospectively organized prewar reporting on Formosa.
